topic: Among patients hospitalized with severe influenza, do convalescent plasma or hyperimmune immunoglobulin products reduce all-cause mortality versus a control product or placebo?

pico.population: Adults or children hospitalized with severe influenza
pico.intervention_or_exposure: Convalescent plasma or hyperimmune intravenous immunoglobulin
pico.comparison: Standard care alone, control plasma, intravenous immunoglobulin, or placebo, with otherwise comparable standard care

targets.population_or_subgroup: Adults or children hospitalized with severe influenza
